nom: Neutrogena Age Shield® Face Oil-free Oxybenzone-free Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 70

avis.texte: Probably my favourite sunscreen of all time. It's the only one that doesn't leave that greasy feeling for me. And with an SPF 70? Totally worth it. I used to use the beach defence one but this is so much better imo. I'd say get the individual packs to try first, that's what I did before i fell in love with them.

avis.titre: Great value when it’s on sale
avis.texte: I bought this sunscreen when it was on sale, and it’s been a great value. It provides good sun protection, feels comfortable on my skin, and the bottle lasts a while. If you can get it at a discount, it’s definitely worth picking up. Great quality for the price.
Really love this cream. Not greasy at all and feels lightweight on my face. Will definitely buy again.
As always, the company does a good job of providing sun protection without white goopy stuff lingering on the skin. Can be worn under makeup.

avis.titre: Perfect sunscreen for adult men... and others as well
avis.texte: I live in the southwest where you have to use sunscreen on your face every day or it will impact your skin. No questions about that. I use this sunscreen every day as it's light weight enough that my face doesn't look greasy or shiny at all, it flat out works (when I miss a spot I know it) and it reasonably priced. I have no idea if this works in combination with anything else like foundation or make-up but I say for any guys out there that want a simple everyday face sunscreen you cannot go wrong with this one. Buy it, use it, protect your skin for years to come.
Lo utilizo diariamente y lo he usado en días de campo y funciona muy bien como protector

avis.titre: FIVE STARS....moisturizes, GREAT protection and cheaper here!
avis.texte: GREAT product especially if you want to keep your skin looking young. I use it as a moisturizer and sunscreen under my light foundation. This is about a month before I turned 70, very fair-skinned (moved from the Southwest partly due to the intense sun for a lot of the year and having to go to the dermatologist a lot) and my face and neck burn in less than a minute...really. I LOVE this as once it dries, doesn't feel greasy, but moisturizing AND I feel more confident in my brief forays in the sun and it helps keep me from burning. I DO USE A LOT, especially on my face, arms, any parts that will get any direct sun, so it helps it's cheaper here.. I also use products like retinol (just at night), which makes my skin MORE sensitive to the sun, so a great sunscreen is a MUST! THIS is the best I have found. . I found this product at Walmart, but price is better here, so will do my next order on Amazon. I also have read that one does not NEED a higher SPF than 70, that higher isn't really going to help me, so if the 70 continues at this price, that's what I get.

I have been using Neutrogena Age Shield for years so when my last bottle was running out I clicked on “buy again”. I didn’t realize it took me to SPF 70 instead of 110 which is what I had been using. When it arrived the bottle was much wider (though both 3 ounces) and the cap removable. I thought it was simply a redesign. However, after using it, the consistency was more watery and my skin got color as if it wasnt working. Fortunately I had saved my last bottle and see that the old one that works much better has an additional major ingredient which this watered down version doesn’t have. I don't like this one.
Su estado no es el mejor, la entrega no fue la que se indico a la hora de la compra

avis.titre: My Order Was Shorted One Unit
avis.texte: I ordered 6 Neutragena Age Shield Face sunscreen units. Only 5 were delivered in box. The app doesn't let me report the problem. How do I get the missing unit?

avis.texte: Received only 1 out of the 3 sunscreens the 1 that I received came in a broken open box I’m not sure if there’s suppose to be a film on the bottle when u take the cap off but there wasn’t extremely disappointed
